title: Density-Guided Bootstrap Boundaries for Latent World-Model Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41022v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Latent world models allow reinforcement learning agents to learn policies from imagined trajectories, yet determining the optimal depth of model reliance remains a fundamental challenge. Fixed imagination horizons apply uniform prediction depths regardless of trajectory reliability, exposing target values to compounding model error or over-relying on critic approximations. We introduce density-guided bootstrap boundaries, a trajectory-dependent mechanism that adapts the depth of imagined returns using a score-informed relative density proxy. The proxy accumulates the estimated divergence of a score-corrected auxiliary field formed by a feature displacement network and a noise-conditioned score estimator along imagined paths. We propose two gating mechanisms: a hard boundary that halts return expansion at a discrete state, and a soft boundary that continuously shifts the return recursion toward critic bootstrapping. translated_title: 面向潜在世界模型强化学习的密度引导自举边界
translated_abstract: 潜在世界模型使强化学习智能体能够从想象的轨迹中学习策略，然而确定模型依赖的最优深度仍然是一个根本性挑战。固定的想象视野无论轨迹可靠性如何都采用统一的预测深度，导致目标值暴露于不断累积的模型误差中，或过度依赖评论家的近似。我们提出了密度引导自举边界，这是一种依赖轨迹的机制，利用分数信息引导的相对密度代理来自适应地调整想象回报的深度。该代理沿着想象路径累积由特征位移网络和噪声条件分数估计器构成的分数校正辅助场的估计散度。我们提出了两种门控机制：一种是在离散状态处停止回报展开的硬边界，另一种是将回报递归连续地转向评论家自举的软边界。两种变体都保持了……
tldr: 该论文提出密度引导自举边界机制，根据轨迹可靠性自适应调整想象回报的展开深度，从而在潜在世界模型强化学习中平衡模型误差累积与对评论家近似的过度依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces density-guided bootstrap boundaries, a trajectory-dependent mechanism that adaptively adjusts the depth of imagined returns based on trajectory reliability, balancing compounding model error and over-reliance on critic approximation in latent world-model reinforcement learning.
